{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained negative sentiment (e.g., multiple -0.25 or 0.00 values) indicating market pessimism.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if true outcome exceeds model forecast by >5% and sentiment is neutral or positive, apply a 10-15% upward correction to next period.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if model consistently overpredicts prices in 3-5 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 2-5% per day to align with historical mean.",
    "Correct for lagged overreaction: if model forecasts a sharp rise after a recent dip, reduce forecast by 5-10% to account for delayed market adjustment.",
    "When sentiment history includes a 0.50 or higher positive sentiment, increase forecast by 3-7% to reflect bullish momentum, especially if true outcome has been trending upward.",
    "For long-term horizons (>10 days), apply a 1-3% downward bias to account for market consolidation or policy-induced volatility.",
    "If model forecast is consistently below true outcome by >10% over 5+ days, consider a 5-10% upward adjustment to reflect structural market strength."
  ]
}
